title: huggingface/transformers v1.0.0 - Name change, new models (XLNet, XLM), unified API for models and tokenizer, access to models internals, torchscript
summary:
Name change: welcome PyTorch-Transformers 👾
pytorch-pretrained-bert => pytorch-transformers
Install with pip install pytorch-transformers
New models
XLNet (from Google/CMU) released with the paper ​XLNet: Generalized Autoregressive Pretraining for Language Understanding by Zhilin Yang, Zihang Dai, Y
